invocation.entrypoint: pronto-server-cloudrun.mjs (HTTP service; Google Cloud Run: pronto-pc, us-central1)

input_contract.description: The outward broker host - the deployed HTTP service the WPF app talks to. It exposes the run's API surface: /api/verify-payment, /api/await-payment, /api/verify-token, /api/native-plan, /api/session/{token}/status, /api/session/{token}/report, /api/report-ai-unavailable, /api/submit-repair-results.

output_contract.description: JSON responses that carry session state, the recorded native plan's admissible action ids, coupons, and reports. It BROKERS and records; it never authors the plan (the on-device model does) and never runs a repair (the app's engine does under consent).

observation_contract.description: The single outward service the Pod owns as a deployment (C2). It hosts the session Orb + stripe/loyalty logic and the native-plan recorder, but holds no diagnostic or repair intelligence: the Model authors on-device, the engine repairs on-device, the backend only gates payment and records evidence.

evidence_contract.description: Deployed revisions are the evidence of what is live (e.g. pronto-pc-00076-hf5 carried the await-payment/verify-token routes, TOTEM-X-0034). certification_preflight.py checks the live backend is responding as part of the reviewer path.

working_parameters.outside_parameters_behavior: A route acts only within a live paid session (the session Orb's gate); an unknown/expired token -> 402. The backend records evidence and gates payment; it authors nothing and repairs nothing.
